verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated reconciliation report suite ('Balance Breakdown Report, Balance Report, Financial Actions by Date Range Report, Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement') explicitly aimed at reconciling balances, fee categories, financial actions, invoices, and settlements, plus a dedicated Settlement Breakdown Report and disputes/fraud reporting that covers chargebacks. This maps directly to the finance-ops reconciliation story covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration (e.g., customer case study or hands-on review) confirming these reports actually reconcile cleanly to bank deposits in practice, and no explicit sample report format shown.
